biocontainers.name: dadi
biocontainers.summary: Fit population genetic models using diffusion approximations to the allele frequency spectrum

biotools.summary: dadi is a bioinformatics tool for inferring demographic history and selection from genetic data using diffusion approximations, offering speed and flexibility in modeling population dynamics. It supports up to three populations with customizable parameters and provides efficient computational performance.
